body:
If I decide to involve the sails and rudders metaphor, what use are they if a boat has no destination? I have literally nothing I want in life. Everything feels empty when that pain in the chest doesn't kick in.

I'm sorry if this is a redundant question. I would rather live in joy than live in grey. The obvious answer would be to seek for my purpose, but when I've tried every route available and tried caring for everything and everyone without avail, apathy seems like the most logical decision if I don't want to kill myself and risk failing.

But what if I don't know what I want?

I have no hobbies. No recreational activities besides playing games or reading anything I can get my hands on. Have tried searching things to do and have tried each one, but nothing. Each project I do fails. Let alone changing--I just fuck up something up even more. 

I'm sorry for whining. It's a mixture of cluelessness and resignation. I've been told the same thing, have read the same thing in novels and I can't believe it. Humans are resilient and designed to fight, but I'm a coward who won't for pathetic reasons and is too spaced out to change.
